thread:
zoe: Quick UX sync on the throughput chart. Two frontend asks: 1) legend overflow behavior when many series, 2) how we surface clipped outliers. Thoughts?

liam: For legend overflow, current behavior drops items into a "+N" menu. That's hard to scan. Suggest a compact two-row stack with horizontal scroll on overflow, plus a "more" popover for actions (hide/copy/inspect). Keyboard: tab to legend, left/right to move, Enter toggles.

priya: Love the two-row stack idea. For screen readers, the "+N" menu should expose a listbox role with aria-label like "hidden series list" so users can quickly get context. Also inline color contrast for small swatches is important when there are many lines.

oliver: Outliers: backend clamps values > 5e6 to reduce axis stretching. Currently we render a flat top and no hint. Propose an "outlier chip" on top-right of chart (small pill: "outliers clipped") with count and we show a chevron on the axis where clipping starts. Clicking the chip opens a modal with examples.

zoe: Nice. The chip should include the clip threshold e.g., "clipped > 5s" and be keyboard focusable. Also it should be dismissible per chart (persist in url state?).

liam: Implementation sketch: add a chartDecoration layer that can render chips and axis markers. CSS idea: .chip {background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); color: #fff; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:999px; font-size:12px;}

priya: Tooltip copy: change from "value: 5,200,000" to "value — 5.2 s (clipped)", and add a subtle "raw: 5200000" line for copy-to-clipboard. Copy ctrl/cmd+C when tooltip focused should copy raw.

oliver: For smoothing toggles we should show a tiny pill in the tooltip header: "smoothed • window=3m" when that mode is active. Avoid mixing this into the main metric line.

zoe: Accessibility checklist proposals (short): 1) legend keyboard nav + focus ring, 2) outlier chip role=button + aria-haspopup=dialog, 3) tooltip has aria-describedby pointing to raw value, 4) ensure axis markers have title attributes.

design-bot: Action created: #DES-511 legend overflow + chip, #A11Y-99 outlier chip focus.

priya: One more nit: axis tick labels currently abbreviate large numbers with suffixes (k/M) but we do inconsistent precision. Decide: use one decimal for k (e.g., 1.2k) and no decimals for M unless <10M (e.g., 3.4M). I'll draft examples.

liam: I'll mock the two-row legend and the chip in Figma and add keyboard states. Target: early next week.

zoe: Perfect. If figs look good I'll file a small frontend task for the decorations layer. Thanks! :sparkles:
